name: framer-draggable-carousel
title: Framer Draggable Carousel
description: A full-width photo slider that moves when you grab and drag it, then springs onto the nearest image. Round arrows and a row of dots offer the same navigation without dragging.
use: A wide image showcase should feel physical, with pulling as natural as clicking the arrows.
avoid: Slides are locked to 400px tall, and twelve image URLs sit hardcoded in the component file.
a11y: Arrows and dots are real buttons but have no accessible names, and pictures are labelled with odd made-up titles. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: One large photo at a time, about 400px tall, with softly rounded corners against a black page. A translucent white circle with a chevron floats at each side, and small white dots sit centred near the bottom, the current one stretched into a short bar.
behaves: Dragging the photo back gives a little elastic resistance; on release the strip springs to the closest slide, or skips ahead when the flick is fast. Arrows and dots jump straight to a slide, and the arrow at either end fades to a disabled state.
customise: Photos and titles are the items array in the file; spring stiffness, drag threshold and the 400px height need source edits.
weight: light: A strip of images moved by one transform, with a spring only after a drag.
